PROPOSED PLACEMENT REGISTER / X, Y, Z metres
Point anchors only. Each is inside its inherited room or industrial zone; equipment size/fit unresolved.
DECK DISTRIBUTION / compact human core only
D01 service waypoint 55.6/5.0/19.0 • P / E / N / W / A / C
D02 service waypoint 55.6/8.8/19.0 • P / E / N / W / A / C
All 12 room service endpoints + branch isolators are expanded individually in Pioneer.json.
Dry power/data and wet water/cooling require separate raceways. Emergency path B cannot share a single failure point.
Human core: supplied/returned air, hotel circuits, data, selected wet fixtures. Occupancy/endurance unresolved.
Engine and cargo reserves: normally unmanned, locally isolated; no automatic cabin atmosphere or crew capacity.
External antennas/radiators are interfaces only. Pressure hull penetrations, skin positions and vessel-scale routing remain open.
Electrical: Voltages, currents, protection discrimination, conductor gauges and fault energy unknown.
Approve load inventory; size conductors and coordinated breaker trips; test safe shedding.
Life support: Crew count, occupancy hours, gas mixture and reserve endurance unknown.
Set occupancy scenarios; size and test atmosphere control and independent reserve.
Water: Tank volume, flow, pressure, treatment chemistry and consumption unknown.
Close mass balance; test isolation, contamination detection and quarantine.
Cooling: Heat loads, fluids, flow, radiator area and operating temperatures unknown.
Close thermal balance; validate independent loops, leak response and heat rejection.
RF / data: Frequencies, link budget, bandwidth, EMC and security boundaries unresolved.
Define permissions and protocols; test segmented control and comms-loss behavior.
Physical routing: Nodes are anchors, not fitted equipment; cables/pipes lack sizes and collision paths.
Fit actual mesh, trays, supports, wall penetrations and maintenance clearance.
Emergency access: One reserved access core is not independent dual egress.
Prove refuge/escape routes, fire zoning, door/lift failure and trapped-person recovery.
Gameplay: Scalar charge is implemented; physical circuits and human-support simulation are not.
Define server state, faults, repair, persistence and authoritative multiplayer acceptance.
CURRENT GAME: station collision blocks hull entry. No ship-interior movement, physical plumbing or circuit simulation supplied.
Numbered endpoints are logical connections, not installed hardware. Planned routes require geometry, safety and runtime validation.
